s: MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB — when and why
d: NoSQL databases solve problems relational databases struggle with: flexible schemas, horizontal scaling, and specific data patterns. Understanding the 4 types (Document, Key-Value, Column, Graph) and when to use each is crucial.

p: NoSQL databases provide flexible schemas and scale horizontally with ease. They come in various types: Document (MongoDB), Key-Value (Redis), Wide-Column (Cassandra), and Graph (Neo4j).
2. Ideal for rapid prototyping or unstructured data.
3. Trades strict ACID consistency for high availability and partition tolerance (CAP Theorem).
